title: Single-sector Praxis with exact tag decryption
claims: params.json is a parameter set of Praxis for the reference statement at 100-bit security whose ciphertext is 5669 MiB (5.5353 GiB) and whose time, one encryption plus one expected decryption, is 26142 million field multiplications (14396 and 11746), by the protected model, and every rule of the model as amended holds for it; proof.md proves that each amended entry (I3, Ncmp, I6, I4, n2, dec_msm_g1, dec_msm_g2, dec_pairings, n1, C6, C7, dec_sum_g2, H2, P1, C5, n, H3, D, ell, Bsearch, T_tr, dec_sum_g1, search_spread) is sound, so that the paper's theorems hold for these parameters as rules.md requires.
